web.title: Alia Web
usage.text:
Alia — local coding agent

Usage:
  alia [MODE] [-- QWEN-ARGS...] Start the agent
    --lang LANG                Language: en, de, auto (default: auto)
    -c, --continue             Continue the latest session
    -r, --resume [ID]          Resume a session
    --fast                     Disable thinking for simple, faster tasks
    --wait-gpu S               Wait up to S seconds for the optional GPU lock
    --auto-edit                Allow file changes automatically
    --yolo                     Allow everything (dangerous)
  alia web [OPTIONS]           Start the Web Shell
    --fast                     Disable thinking for simple, faster tasks
    --wait-gpu S               Wait up to S seconds for the optional GPU lock
    --auto-edit                Allow file changes automatically
    --yolo                     Allow everything (dangerous)
    --port N                   Port (default: 4170)
    --no-open                  Do not open a browser automatically
    --workspace DIR            Set the primary workspace
  alia doctor                  Run diagnostics
  alia status                  Show server status
  alia profiles                Show profiles
  alia use <profile-id|auto>   Pin/reset a profile
  alia lang <en|de|auto>       Set/reset the language
  alia mcp [list]              List optional MCP servers
  alia mcp enable <name>       Enable browser or search (opt-in)
  alia mcp disable <name>      Disable an MCP server
  alia mcp test [name]         Start MCP servers and list their tools
  alia stop                    Stop the server
  alia logs                    Follow the server log
  alia --version               Show version
